description: The bar chart illustrates the scores of three models, SRPO-7B, GRPO-7B, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B, across four categories: MathVista, MathVerse, MMMU-Pro, and Physics. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, while the vertical axis is labeled "Score" and ranges from 35 to 80 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 5. Each category is represented by a group of three bars, colored dark blue, blue, and light blue, corresponding to SRPO-7B, GRPO-7B, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B, respectively. The scores for SRPO-7B are approximately 75.8, 55.8, 42.3, and 60.6 for the four categories, respectively, while GRPO-7B scores are around 72.3, 52.9, 39.9, and 53.5, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B scores are about 68.2, 46.3, 36.9, and 45.4. The bars within each category are not sorted, but the categories themselves are presented in a fixed order. The chart does not visually emphasize any particular bar or category.
